text: A server-side check that pending plus succeeded refunds never exceed the captured amount (failed refunds excluded), and that the check holds when two admins refund the same payment at once.
Only captured payments can be refunded, only by admins with refund permission, a reason from the fixed list is required, and only the server calls the provider.
Our own refund record is created in a pending state, and its idempotency key is reused on every provider call for that refund.
The provider-call failure rules: 10-second timeout, up to 3 retries with the same key on timeout or 5xx, and an immediate failure with no retry and the provider's message shown to the admin on 4xx.
The final status comes from verified, signed succeeded/failed webhooks, and duplicate or out-of-order deliveries are handled safely.
A mechanism that checks pending refunds directly with the provider so that none stays pending for more than 24 hours unchecked.
The customer email (sent once) and the order status change (Partially refunded or Refunded, from succeeded refunds only) happen only after the refund succeeds.
Audit entries for every refund request and every status change.
